breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 13 close (mimics MMFI). Up from 69.9% and back above the 70 line.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed slipped to 39 (fear) from 40 as chip stocks sold off, still far above 24 a week ago but below 46 a month ago, so sentiment remains cautious rather than confident.

markets.summary: Stocks ended a volatile week mixed but still posted weekly gains, the S&P 500's first winning week since early October. On Friday the S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq 0.9% to 25,136.27, while the Dow edged up 0.1% to 52,347.55; for the week the S&P gained 2.5%, the Nasdaq 2.3% and the Dow 2.1%. Tech led the decline as Nvidia fell another 2% to $162.85 after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation and chip stocks like AMD and Broadcom slid. Small caps were roughly flat, with the Russell 2000 down 0.3% to 2,790.49 and still below its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% after October PPI rose 0.3%, a bit cooler than expected but up 6.5% from a year ago, with futures pricing about a 90% chance of a December Fed rate hike. Gold futures held at about $3,886 after Thursday's slump and finished roughly 4.7% lower on the week, while silver futures dropped about 1.9% to $49.03; both sit well below their 40-week averages. Next week brings Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday and a SpaceX Starship ship-catch attempt on Saturday.

stories.headline: US stocks: Nasdaq ends lower as Nvidia uncertainty weighs on tech shares
stories.summary: Nvidia fell 2% for its sixth straight weekly decline, the longest streak since 2012, and the Financial Times reported its board approached Arm CEO Rene Haas about succeeding Huang.

stories.headline: Nasdaq drops Friday but ends the week up
stories.summary: Nvidia's first earnings report without Huang is due after Tuesday's close, raising the stakes for a stock that has shed 2% more on Friday.

stories.headline: SpaceX launches Starship on 22-hour Flight 15 test, but aborts booster catch
stories.summary: Ship reached orbit and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites, but the Super Heavy booster catch was called off and it splashed down in the Gulf; the ship's first-ever return-and-catch at Starbase is planned for Saturday afternoon.

stories.headline: SpaceX launches 15th Starship flight; aborts booster recovery maneuver
stories.summary: Reuters and NBC report the booster exploded just above the water after the abort, while the upper stage reached orbit about 27 minutes after liftoff.

stories.headline: Cameco Corp. stock falls Friday, underperforms market
stories.summary: Cameco's Toronto shares slid 1.53% to C$100.80, about 45% below the C$182.72 high set in January.

stories.headline: Paradigm Capital upgrades Cameco to Buy and lowers target to C$130
stories.summary: Paradigm moved Cameco from Hold to Buy on Nov. 9 while cutting its 12-month target from C$150 to C$130 after Q3 production and cost updates.

headlines.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Friday 11/13/2026
headlines.summary: Stocks fell in shaky trading as AI-related shares pulled back, but the market still posted its first winning week since early October.

headlines.headline: Gold posts steep weekly loss as Treasury yields rise, Fed tightening bets persist
headlines.summary: Spot gold ended near $3,883 and silver fell 2.6% to about $48.63 as October PPI rose 6.5% year over year and markets priced about an 89% chance of a 25-basis-point December hike.

stories.headline: Laubacher ousts Boebert in Colorado's 4th Congressional District
stories.summary: Democrat Eileen Laubacher has won the 4th District seat, which includes Douglas County, unseating Republican Rep. Lauren Boebert.

stories.headline: National ground stop snarls flights at DIA before being lifted
stories.summary: An FAA nationwide ground stop lasting more than four hours caused hundreds of delays and cancellations, including at Denver International Airport, before it was lifted Friday.

stories.headline: FAA nationwide ground stop grounds flights for hours
stories.summary: A nationwide FAA ground stop Friday left travelers stuck on tarmacs; NPR reports outdated technology that 'got overloaded' was blamed, and DHS head Markwayne Mullin said there was no threat to the U.S.

stories.headline: Democrat Kreiss-Tomkins wins Alaska governor's race
stories.summary: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has won the race for Alaska governor, replacing a Republican.

stories.headline: GOP state officials push to revive Trump's mail-voting limits for 2028
stories.summary: Republican state officials are working to bring back President Trump's mail-voting restrictions ahead of the 2028 election.

stories.headline: Trump's Iran strategy: keep things as they are
stories.summary: NPR analysis finds the administration's current approach to Iran is to maintain the status quo.

stories.headline: No. 5 Michigan State hits school-record 18 threes in 106-72 rout of Northern Iowa
stories.summary: Jeremy Fears Jr. scored 24 with nine assists and freshman Jasiah Jervis added a career-best 20 as the Spartans (4-0) broke the program 3-point record three days after beating No. 2 Duke; MSU plays at No. 11 Tennessee on Tuesday.

stories.headline: Desperate Nation Offers Microsoft $100 Billion To Not Fix Outlook
stories.summary: Satire: after the Outlook outage, the country would rather keep its inbox broken.

stories.headline: Folgers Voted Best Coffee To Dump Out And Then Use Container To Store Random Screws
stories.summary: Satire: the brand finally wins an award for its true purpose in the garage.

stories.headline: Marine with extremely low IQ thrilled by switch to Super Intelligence
stories.summary: Satire: the Pentagon's AI pivot finds an unexpectedly enthusiastic fan.

weather.summary: An atmospheric river is pushing heavy rain and mountain snow from the West Coast toward the Four Corners and Southern Plains, with another arriving Sunday; heavy rain shifts to the Southern Plains and Lower Mississippi Valley this weekend with isolated flash flooding possible. In the East, a deep trough keeps lake-effect snow showers going around the Great Lakes through Saturday and brings a possible first freeze of the season from the Midwest into the Mid-Atlantic.
